topic: Section 144 - Services not to be rendered
question: Which of the following services by an auditor is not restricted under Section 144 of the Companies Act 2013?
explanation: Section 144 bars an auditor from providing accounting and book keeping, internal audit, design of financial information systems, actuarial, investment advisory, investment banking, outsourced financial services and management services to the company. Issuing a deposit return certificate is not barred.

why_not.A: Actuarial services are expressly barred under Section 144.
why_not.B: Rendering outsourced financial services is expressly barred.
why_not.C: Investment advisory services are expressly barred.

exam_tip: Remember the Section 144 bar list: accounting, internal audit, actuarial, investment advisory/banking, outsourced financial, management services.
check_notes: Explanation abbreviates the Section 144 item as 'design of financial information systems'; the Act says 'design and implementation of any financial information system'.
The exam tip's 'bar list' leaves out the financial information system design and implementation item and the 'any other kind of services as may be prescribed' item, so the list is incomplete.
